schema.text: Has the lack of safe bike parking ever made you change plans or leave your bike at home?

ar.#Has the lack of safe bike parking ever: هل حدث أن اضطرك غياب مواقف الدراجات الآمنة إلى تغيير خططك أو ترك دراجتك في المنزل؟

de.#Has the lack of safe bike parking ever: Hat der Mangel an sicheren Fahrradabstellplätzen Sie schon einmal dazu gebracht, Pläne zu ändern oder Ihr Rad zu Hause zu lassen?

en.#Has the lack of safe bike parking ever: Has the lack of safe bike parking ever made you change plans or leave your bike at home?

fa.#Has the lack of safe bike parking ever: آیا نبود جای امن برای دوچرخه تا حالا باعث شده برنامه‌تان را تغییر دهید یا دوچرخه را در خانه بگذارید؟

fr.#Has the lack of safe bike parking ever: Le manque de stationnement sûr pour les vélos vous a-t-il déjà fait changer vos projets ou laisser votre vélo à la maison ?

hu.#Has the lack of safe bike parking ever: Előfordult már, hogy a biztonságos kerékpártárolók hiánya miatt megváltoztatta a terveit, vagy otthon hagyta a biciklijét?

it.#Has the lack of safe bike parking ever: La mancanza di parcheggi sicuri per la bici ti ha mai fatto cambiare programmi o lasciare la bici a casa?

tr.#Has the lack of safe bike parking ever: Güvenli bisiklet park yeri eksikliği hiç planlarınızı değiştirmenize veya bisikletinizi evde bırakmanıza neden oldu mu?
